This document is the basis for extending the program and rebuilding every flow as translatable universal HTML blocks.

How the flows work together

One journey at a time. The four conversion flows form a ladder: Site Abandonment excludes anyone who viewed a product, Browse excludes anyone who added to cart, Cart excludes anyone who started checkout. A visitor only ever receives the deepest-funnel sequence that applies to them.

Buying stops everything. Nearly every flow checks “no order since entering” before each send, so a purchase mid-sequence ends the emails.

Value first, discount last. Every sequence leads with saved work, trust and help; a code only appears late (cart/checkout email 4, winback email 3) and always with an expiry follow-up.

Issues to fix before go-live

Found during the audit of 19 Aug 2026. Each becomes part of the rebuild scope.

  1. Text-in-image templates everywhere (except Welcome v2): untranslatable, invisible with images off, unreadable for screen readers. The core reason for the rebuild.
  2. No unsubscribe link in RFB templates (verified on Welcome; check the rest). Compliance risk. The rebuilt Email #2 already fixes this.
  3. UTM tracking is off on every email: no GA/attribution once live. Define the UTM convention and enable per flow.
  4. Smart Sending is off everywhere while journeys can overlap (Welcome + Browse + Cart + Site can all hit the same prospect in one week). Enable Smart Sending or add cross-flow exclusions.
  5. Site Abandonment filter bug: requires Placed Order > 0 since flow start; should almost certainly be = 0.
  6. Post-Purchase conditional split is a no-op (Placed Order > 0 all time is always true after an order); intent was likely first-order-only (= 1).
  7. Broken personalization markers [[ viewed product name ]] in Browse Abandonment emails 4 and 5 subject lines: would send verbatim.
  8. Copy bug: Post-Purchase email 4 reuses email 3's preview text (“Simple tips, no jargon.”).
  9. Post-Purchase vs transactional overlap: emails 1, 2 and 5 partly duplicate the transactional order confirmation / expectations / review emails.
  10. VIP mechanics undefined: “early access” has no backing mechanic; the buyer-guard filter conflicts with a loyalty audience.
  11. Sunset property is a dead end: nothing excludes Sunset Unengaged profiles yet.
  12. Broken or wrong footer links in RFB templates (LinkedIn icon pointed at Instagram; help links pointed at non-existent /help pages; the real Help Centre is /{locale}/cs). Audit all footers in the rebuild.
  13. Winback timing compresses four emails into four days after a 90-day silence; consider spacing.

Rebuild tracker

Rebuild = each email as one translatable universal HTML block (visual of the originals, real text, pre-faded hero photos), proven on Welcome Email #2.

5 emails · Flow TZYvDF · Status: draft

Trigger

Placed Order
Fires on the Placed Order event; a conditional split then checks purchase history (see flag).

Audience

Ireland + United Kingdom only

None

Overlap with the transactional program: emails 1, 2 and 5 partly duplicate the transactional order confirmation, expectation-setting and review request. Decide the behavioural vs transactional split before go-live.
